The FERC filing is specifically a section 157.205 'prior notice' request under Transco's existing blanket certificate (Docket No. CP82-426-000) -- a smaller/faster authorization type than a full section 7(c) certificate application, consistent with the project's small footprint (three delivery meter stations + one compressor-station/valve-site expansion, no new mainline pipe).
